About the Practice

Buffalo General Medical Center/Gates Vascular Institute, part of the Kaleida Health system, is a 526-bed acute care medical center located in downtown Buffalo, NY. It serves as a core teaching hospital for the Jacobs School of Medicine and Biomedical Sciences. [3, 16] The center provides comprehensive medical, surgical, and emergency care, and is recognized for its innovative treatments. [3] Key specialties and services include cardiac and vascular care, neurosciences, advanced orthopaedic and spine surgery, bariatric (weight loss) surgery, general and complex surgery, minimally invasive surgery, gynecologic surgery, oncology, emergency services, and imaging. [2, 3, 8]

Research Analysis
Methodology & Findings

Buffalo General Medical Center, part of Kaleida Health, utilizes the MyKaleida Patient Portal for patient access to health information. This portal is accessible through the HealtheLife mobile app. The HealtheLife patient portal is a product offered by Cerner, indicating that Kaleida Health likely uses Cerner as their Electronic Health Record (EHR) vendor.
